lang.label: Language
tip.sort: Sorts the people in the queue
tip.resort: Puts everyone back in the queue and sorts again
tip.reset: Puts everyone in the teams back in the queue
confirm.clear: Clear the queue and the teams?
opt.multivoice: several teams at the same time
tip.multivoice: Each team can have someone with the voice at the same time; the lines play one at a time
tip.next_in_team: Another person from the same team as the last one picked
tip.skip: Skips only the line in progress (stuck generating or playing); the queue of lines goes on
test.placeholder: test TTS on the team's goblin…
spk.hint: pick a team or a person
tip.autoremove: Anyone in the queue or in a team who stays this long without writing in the chat is removed. Only counts while the chat is connected.
opt.autorotate: switch who has the voice every
tip.volume: How loud the goblins speak in OBS (and in the panel, when no OBS source is open). Applies right away, even to the line playing.
tip.autorotate: After this time, the voice goes to another random person from the same team (waits for the current line to finish).
tint.label: tint
tip.stop_team: Take the voice from this team
tip.test_voice: This team's goblin says a fixed phrase with the team's voice ({detail})
detail.profile_chosen: profile chosen in the Voice tab
opt.hideidle: hide the goblin of teams that have no voice
tip.hideidle: Each team's source only shows the goblin while someone on the team has the voice (or during a team speech test). The main source already works this way.
drawer.images_hint: Each team can have its own png + gif pair; without its own image, it uses the default. Each team's tint (in the team column) is applied on top.
url.hint: Each team source shows the goblin and plays only its team's lines. The main one plays the lines of teams without their own source. The green dot means the source is open in OBS. The goblin fills the whole source: set the size with the source's width and height in OBS (640 × 400 fits well).
tip.purge_whisper: Unloads Whisper (transcription) and frees its VRAM. It comes back by itself on the next transcription.
vz.s.loading: loading the voice model… (the first time downloads ~3 GB)
vz.s.switching: switching to {model}… lines that arrive meanwhile are not spoken
vz.env_missing:
The voice server environment (PyTorch + OmniVoice) was not found.
Install it with tts_server\setup.ps1 and then click Restart server.
tip.profiles_dir: Each data folder has its own profiles
vz.install_time: {elapsed}s · it can take 10–20 min, depending on your internet
vz.install_title: The voice server (OmniVoice) is not installed yet.
vz.install_body: The installation downloads ~3.5 GB (Python, PyTorch with CUDA and OmniVoice; ~8 GB on disk) to {dir}. On the first start, the voice model (~3 GB) is also downloaded. It needs an NVIDIA GPU to be fast.
vz.drop_hint: or click to choose · 3–20s of clean speech works best
step.review_hint: check the text and the name
vz.transcript_label: Transcript (what is said in the audio)
vz.reftext_placeholder: type exactly what is said in the audio…
vz.profiles_empty: no profiles yet — create one above
vz.edit_hint: Changing the transcript recreates the profile's voice.
toast.server_not_ready: the voice server is not ready yet
vz.scope_hint_global: Applies to all profiles. ↺ goes back to the model's default.
vz.scope_hint_profile: Applies only to this profile. Faded fields inherit the global value; ↺ goes back to inheriting.
tip.reset_inherit: go back to inheriting the global value
confirm.discard_params: Discard the unsaved changes to the parameters?
vz.test_text: Hey chat! I am the goblin and today I will read your messages.
vz.test_hint: Uses the form's parameters, even before saving.
vz.team_voices_hint: Whoever has the voice speaks with their team's profile. Teams without a profile use the default.
confirm.restart: Restart the voice server? The model will be reloaded.
confirm.switch_model: Switch the voice model to {model}? The server restarts, and lines that arrive while it loads are not spoken.
confirm.power_off: Turn the voice model off? The VRAM is freed; the goblins have no OmniVoice voice until you turn it on again.
param.language.label: Language
param.language.help: Language of the spoken text. Setting it improves quality a little.
param.speed.label: Speed
param.num_step.label: Decoding steps
param.num_step.help: More steps = better quality, but slower. 16 is ~2x faster.
param.guidance_scale.label: Guidance strength (CFG)
param.guidance_scale.help: How much the model follows the text and the reference voice.
param.denoise.label: Remove noise
param.denoise.help: Asks the model for clean output, without the reference's noise.
param.normalize_text.label: Normalize text
param.normalize_text.help: Turns numbers, dates and currencies into their spoken form.
param.instruct.label: Voice style (no profile)
param.instruct.help: Only when no profile is used. E.g. 'female, low pitch'. Trained on English/Chinese.
param.t_shift.label: t_shift
param.layer_penalty_factor.label: Layer penalty
param.position_temperature.label: Position temperature
param.class_temperature.label: Class temperature
param.postprocess_output.label: Post-process output
param.audio_chunk_duration.label: Chunk length (s)
param.audio_chunk_duration.help: Long texts are generated in chunks of this size.
param.audio_chunk_threshold.label: Split threshold (s)
param.audio_chunk_threshold.help: Audio predicted above this is split into chunks.
param.pad_duration.label: Edge silence (s)
param.fade_duration.label: Fade (s)
msg.all_back: everyone is back in the queue
msg.added_already: {user} is already in the queue or in a team
msg.multivoice_on: several teams can speak at the same time
msg.multivoice_off: only one person has the voice at a time
msg.hideidle_on: team goblins disappear while the team has no voice
msg.autoremove_on: inactive people leave after {minutes} min without chatting
msg.autoremove_off: removal of inactive people is off
msg.autorotate_on: the voice changes person every {minutes} min
msg.testvoice_full: test queue full, wait a moment
msg.skipped_generating: line from {user} skipped (it was being generated)
err.invalid_channel: invalid channel: {channel} (use just the name, e.g. mychannel)

err.bad_minutes: minutes must be a number between 0 and 1440
err.team_count: the number of teams must be 1..{max}
err.not_in_game: {user} is not in the queue or in a team
notice.queue_closed: {user} tried to join, but the queue is closed
notice.voice_moved: the voice of team {team} went to {user}
notice.no_overlay_team: no overlay with audio for team {team}
notice.no_overlay_no_team: no overlay with audio for whoever has no team
http.asset_not_image: the file is not a valid {kind}
tts.external_restart: the TTS server was started outside the app; restart it there
tts.external_stop: the TTS server was started outside the app; turn it off there
tts.manual_setup: this voice server is set up by hand (tts_server/setup.ps1)
tts.model_not_installed: {model} is not installed: run {script}, then pick it again
